# T-1: Track plugin update results

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose enough package update metadata for plugin update-all to decide whether automatic upgrade is required.

## Acceptance Criteria
- syncInstalledPlugins update mode returns `previousCommit`, `commit`, and `updated` for each processed enabled package.
- No-update packages return `updated: false` with identical previous and current commits.
- Install result remains able to identify installed package id, source, and commit.
- Overlay-only private plugin source/package data from `.senti/config.local.json` is not written to public `.senti/config.json`.

## Implementation Notes
`src/lib/plugin-registry.js` owns package commit comparison because it reads existing config and resolved source commits. Preserve the existing MAX_ENABLED_PLUGIN_PACKAGES bound of 100 enabled packages. Upgrade decision/output metadata may use merged config, but writes must preserve the existing public/local config boundary. Do not execute plugin-side scripts while collecting update metadata.

## Test Strategy
Use spec-local fixtures for one package whose source commit advances, a no-update case where stored commit already equals resolved commit, an over-100 enabled package bound case, and an overlay-only private plugin source/package case that verifies public config is not polluted.
